rubrics.justification: Detailed and largely consistent with a 3AA expanded blastocyst, appropriately describing expanded cavity, compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona. Some image-specific claims (exact quadrant, absence of subtle artifacts) are slightly overconfident.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, endometrium, BMI, male-factor context, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to morphology, age, and ploidy uncertainty. Minor overreach includes strong claims about kinetics/euploidy and some speculative future-workup suggestions.

Recommendations are mostly evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, especially SET for a good-prognosis 33-year-old with a top-quality blastocyst. Slight deviations include suggesting ERA, thrombophilia/immunologic workup, and possible PGT-A use more broadly than guidelines typically support after a first failed transfer.
Provides clear next steps for transfer management, luteal support, transfer technique, follow-up timing, and contingency planning for future cycles with practical specificity.
